events.description:
Cairokee return to Cairo International Stadium for the closing night of the Roots tour.

Expect the full catalogue, a fifteen-piece string section and a stage design built specifically for this venue. Gates open two hours early with food trucks and a record fair on the concourse.
events.refund_policy: Full refunds up to 7 days before the event.
events.subtitle: The full band, one night only, under the Cairo sky.
events.title: Cairokee — Roots Live

events.description:
Sandbox returns to Sidi Abdel Rahman for its tenth edition.

Three stages, forty artists, and a beach that stays open until the sun comes up. Camping and shuttle passes are sold separately.
events.subtitle: Three days of house, techno and sunrise sets on the North Coast.
events.title: Sandbox Beach Festival
